{{< lipsum 3 >}}

One shortcode gives you the button, the script, and the bundled arrival sound.

```markdown
{{{< elevator >}}}
```

{{< elevator "Return to the top!" audio=BossaBossa.mp3 volume=0.4 >}}

The button above adds the music and turns the volume down:

```markdown
{{{< elevator "Return to the top!" audio=BossaBossa.mp3 volume=0.4 >}}}
```

Only one button per page: each shortcode wires the first one on the page.

Full documentation: <https://m.canouil.dev/quarto-elevator/>.
